dc_perm_ex_v1.title: Permanently excited DC motor (GEM, Heinzmann PMG 132 parameters), one-quadrant converter

fields.name: scenario_id
fields.description: Unique run name; becomes dataset_id and source_file in the export.

fields.name: controller_type
fields.description: Controller of the run; each plant accepts only its own controllers.

fields.name: omega_ref_rad_s
fields.convention: mechanical shaft speed
fields.description: Speed reference of the speed PI/MPC. The one-quadrant converter cannot track negative references or brake.

fields.name: fault_type
fields.description: None (healthy), outer_race, inner_race, ball, cage, or a custom label with fault_order_override.

fields.name: electrical_severity
fields.convention: amplitude of the bearing-fault torque ripple (MCSA path)
fields.description: Electrical fault severity; only acts when a fault is active.

fields.name: mechanical_severity
fields.convention: impulse amplitude of the synthetic vibration model (Module B)
fields.description: Mechanical fault severity; default is the calibrated value of the fault type.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Reproducibility seed (DC: plant randomness, vibration and noise; VSC: the reference's start phase; PMSM and buck: recorded, deterministic runs).

fields.name: duration_s
fields.description: Simulated time of the run.

fields.name: plant_config_id
fields.description: Which plant to simulate.

fields.name: motor_parameter_overrides
fields.description: Partial override of the DC motor's electrical and mechanical parameters.

r_a.convention: armature circuit resistance (two-terminal, brushes included as given by the datasheet); temperature not stated by GEM: prefer the cold value and say so

psi_e.convention: flux constant = back-EMF constant Ke in V*s/rad = torque constant Kt in N*m/A (SI)

j_rotor.convention: rotor inertia only; the load adds j_load = 0.0025

fields.name: electrical_noise_pct
fields.convention: white noise on current_r, as % of the run's own standard deviation
fields.description: Sensor noise on the current, added after the run.

fields.name: mechanical_noise_pct
fields.convention: white noise on each acceleration axis, as % of that axis's standard deviation
fields.description: Sensor noise on the vibration channels, added after the run.

fields.name: torque_ref_nm
fields.description: Torque-control mode (bypasses the speed loop); omega_ref_rad_s is then ignored.

fields.name: fault_order_override
fields.description: Characteristic fault frequency as an order; makes fault_type a free label.

fields.name: extra_faults
fields.description: Additional simultaneous faults, as (fault_type, order_override) pairs.

fields.name: pi_setpoint_weight
fields.description: Setpoint weight b of the speed PI's proportional term (PI only).

fields.name: dc_plant_solver
fields.description: Reference integration of the DC plant (studies only; None = one Euler step per period).

fields.name: dc_plant_substeps
fields.description: Euler substeps per control period (with dc_plant_solver euler or unset).

fields.name: load_torque_nm
fields.convention: absolute passive load torque (Coulomb-type, opposes rotation), added to the default friction constant a (0.01 for the stock motor; 1 % of rated torque for another motor with known ratings)
fields.description: Constant load torque; '20 % load' must be converted with the motor's rated torque by the caller.

fields.name: dc_supply_v
fields.convention: DC link of the one-quadrant converter
fields.description: Supply voltage.

fields.name: dc_limit_overrides
fields.default_source: dc_perm_ex_v1: DcPermanentlyExcitedMotor._default_limits, not derived from motor_parameter_overrides; dc_pmg132_v1: runner.PMG132_LIMITS
fields.description: Motor limits: normalisation and the controllers' current cap (PI 0.8 x i, MPC 0.85 x i). u must not exceed dc_supply_v.

i.convention: armature current; for a datasheet, the peak (short-time) current, not the continuous one

fields.name: dc_nominal_overrides
fields.description: Rated values (continuous duty, S1); the tuning's J_effort uses the rated current.

pmsm_v1.title: Salient PMSM, dq current control near standstill (current-step bench)

fields.name: scenario_id
fields.description: Unique run name; becomes dataset_id and source_file in the export.

fields.name: controller_type
fields.default_source: no default for pmsm_v1: must be set
fields.description: Controller of the run; each plant accepts only its own controllers.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Reproducibility seed (DC: plant randomness, vibration and noise; VSC: the reference's start phase; PMSM and buck: recorded, deterministic runs).

fields.name: duration_s
fields.description: Simulated time of the run.

fields.name: plant_config_id
fields.default_source: no default for pmsm_v1: must be set
fields.description: Which plant to simulate.

fields.name: pmsm_current_ref_a
fields.convention: signed stator current magnitude |i_s| (amplitude-invariant dq, peak per phase); sign = sign of i_q
fields.description: Stator current reference, split into (i_d, i_q) by the policy.

fields.name: pmsm_motor_parameters
fields.default_source: control/classical/pmsm_foc.MOTOR_PARAMS (GEM PermanentMagnetSynchronousMotor), j_rotor GEM default, u_supply pmsm_foc.U_SUPPLY
fields.description: Partial override of the PMSM. MTPA assumes l_q >= l_d.

l_d.convention: d-axis inductance per phase (star equivalent); a line-to-line value is about 2x

r_s.convention: stator resistance per phase (star equivalent) = R_line-line / 2; cold value

psi_p.convention: permanent-magnet flux linkage, PEAK per phase (torque = 1.5*p*psi_p*i_q with amplitude-invariant dq)

j_rotor.convention: rotor inertia; the bench adds a 5 kg*m^2 load inertia

u_supply.convention: DC link of the B6 bridge

vsc_dpc_v1.title: Voltage source converter with L-C filter, DPC neural controller

fields.name: scenario_id
fields.description: Unique run name; becomes dataset_id and source_file in the export.

fields.name: controller_type
fields.default_source: no default for vsc_dpc_v1: must be set
fields.description: Controller of the run; each plant accepts only its own controllers.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Reproducibility seed (DC: plant randomness, vibration and noise; VSC: the reference's start phase; PMSM and buck: recorded, deterministic runs).

fields.name: duration_s
fields.description: Simulated time of the run.

fields.name: plant_config_id
fields.default_source: no default for vsc_dpc_v1: must be set
fields.description: Which plant to simulate.

fields.name: load_resistance_ohm
fields.convention: resistive load across the output capacitor
fields.default_source: VSC: runner._VSC_R_OHM = 8.0064 (the DPC training load); buck: 6 ohm
fields.description: Output load. VSC below R* = 3.37 ohm is open-loop unstable (physics, not rejected).

fields.name: reference_magnitude_v
fields.convention: magnitude of the rotating voltage reference (complex phasor)
fields.description: Reference voltage magnitude; the network was trained at 50 V.

fields.name: reference_omega_rad_s
fields.convention: electrical angular frequency of the reference
fields.description: Reference frequency; the network was trained at 50 Hz.

fields.name: vsc_voltage_limit_v
fields.convention: per-axis clamp of the converter voltage command
fields.description: Converter voltage limit; 134 V reproduces the original converter (S-09). None: unlimited.

fields.name: vsc_capacitor_scale
fields.description: Synthetic capacitor degradation (effective C); synthetic-only fault.

fields.name: vsc_esr_ohm
fields.description: Synthetic series ESR of the filter capacitor.

buck_v1.title: Averaged synchronous buck converter, PI cascade

fields.name: scenario_id
fields.description: Unique run name; becomes dataset_id and source_file in the export.

fields.name: controller_type
fields.description: Controller of the run; each plant accepts only its own controllers.

fields.name: seed
fields.description: Reproducibility seed (DC: plant randomness, vibration and noise; VSC: the reference's start phase; PMSM and buck: recorded, deterministic runs).

fields.name: duration_s
fields.description: Simulated time of the run.

fields.name: plant_config_id
fields.default_source: no default for buck_v1: must be set
fields.description: Which plant to simulate.

fields.name: load_resistance_ohm
fields.convention: resistive load across the output capacitor
fields.default_source: VSC: runner._VSC_R_OHM = 8.0064 (the DPC training load); buck: 6 ohm
fields.description: Output load. VSC below R* = 3.37 ohm is open-loop unstable (physics, not rejected).

fields.name: buck_vout_ref_v
fields.description: Output voltage reference.
fields.range_note: upper bound is buck_vin_v (48 V by default): a buck cannot step up

fields.name: buck_vin_v
fields.description: Input voltage.
fields.range_note: must exceed buck_vout_ref_v (24 V by default); on its own only > 0 is required

fields.name: buck_load_step_ohm
fields.description: Load after the step; None: no step.

fields.name: buck_load_step_time_s
fields.description: Time of the load step.

fields.name: buck_parameter_overrides
fields.description: Partial override of the buck's components.

i_max_a.convention: inductor current limit of the controller
